name: @wafflebase/desktop
description: Desktop shell (Tauri 2) that opens a Wafflebase deployment in a native window

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "for (const f of ['src-tauri/tauri.conf.json', 'src-tauri/capabilities/local.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))"
